annotations.title: Share HTML as a tracked link

description: Publishes an HTML document — a deck, report, dashboard, proposal or one-pager — as a tracked HTMLRadar link, and returns two addresses: the link for the recipient, and a dashboard address for the sender. The recipient sees the document as written and never the tracking. The markup goes in `html`; there is no file-path argument, so a document on disk reaches this tool only as markup the caller has already read, which leaves the user's permissions on their own file tools in charge of what is published. By default the recipient is asked for their email address before the document opens, which is a step the person receiving the link has to take. The link is live the moment it is returned. Images that need a login, expiring image addresses and local file paths do not load for readers of the link. Images embedded in the HTML as data URIs always do; compressed, they keep the whole document under the 5 MB limit.

allowed_email_domains.description: Only these email domains may open the link, e.g. ["acme.com"]. Up to 500.

allowed_emails.description: Only these exact addresses may open the link, e.g. ["ravi@acme.com"]. A separate list from the domains, and a visitor passes on either. Up to 500 addresses; past that a domain is the right tool. Needs the email gate, which is on by default; with it off the call is refused.

expires_in_hours.description: Link stops working after this many hours.

html.description: The HTML markup to publish, in full. There is no file-path argument: a document on disk reaches this tool only as markup the caller has already read.

lock_deck.description: Blocks save and print and adds a watermark; default true. Pass false for a document the recipient is meant to keep a copy of.

password.description: Extra password gate on top of the email gate.

recipient_label.description: Who this link is for, e.g. "Acme". One link per recipient reads best.

require_email.description: Ask the recipient for their email before the document opens. Defaults to true.

slug.description: Custom link name, so the URL reads /r/acme-proposal. Paid plans only.

title.description: Name shown on your dashboard. Recipients do not see it.

verify_email.description: Verify that the address really is the reader's: we email a six-digit code and open the document only when the reader types it back. Off by default. Use it when the list of who opened the document has to be true rather than merely typed. Needs the email gate, which is on by default; with it off the call is refused.
